description: Lockstep looks like a clean link to the client: the harness delivers every server tick's snapshot 10 ms apart on the page's clock (calls, waits and frames alike), so the remotes' adaptive interpolation delay settles at the clean-link value (two snapshot intervals and a tick: 30 ms) and stays there while players move. It read 50-220 ms when a frame's ticks or a wait's arrived in one burst.
